name: dc-gazala-coop-rec
description: Desert Combat Gazala co-op with the server-side recorder preloaded, bots only: DC's overlay of the vanilla level (vanilla's AI data), the co-op layer that places the AC-130 (El Alamein Day 2's names it in its templates and places none). Also Mi-24/Mi-8/AH-64/UH-60L, MiG-29/Su-25/F-16/F-15C/A-10B, the DPV, T-72/M1A1, BMP-2/M2A3, M163/Shilka, BM-21/MLRS, M-109/M-1974. Needs `lab.py setup --mods-from-client DesertCombat`.
human: No client needed: the server records itself. One round, then `lab.py stop`.
